sources.title: Hskyto/lfm2.5-2.6b-toolcall-mlx-q8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-2.6B Tool-Call MLX (16-Bit Master) This repository contains the unquantized 16-bit (Bfloat16) MLX version of Liquid AI's LFM2.5-2.6B, merged with a custom QLoRA adapter trained specifically for on-device tool and function calling on Apple Silicon and native iOS integration.

sources.title: LFM2.5-2.6B: Deploy Agents Everywhere | Blog | Liquid AI
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-2.6B is an on-device agentic model that plans, calls tools, and runs multi-step tasks at 220 tok/s in under 2.5 GB. Open weights on Hugging Face.

sources.title: GitHub - Hemeskyo/lfm2-toolcalling-qlora: Bare QLoRA fine-tune of LFM2 ...
sources.snippet: Fine-tuning Liquid AI's LFM2.5-2.6B — a hybrid convolution + attention on-device model — with QLoRA (4-bit + LoRA), to specialize it on function calling (tool use). Everything is done "bare" with Hugging Face PEFT + TRL + bitsandbytes A learning-in-public project, and the next step after building a transformer from scratch in miniGPT.
